feature1.prompt: Make the element_id argument of json_script optional. I recently had a use-case where I wanted to use json_script without needing an id because it was included inside a <template> tag. There is no compelling security or functional reason to require an id, and making it optional improves flexibility in template rendering. The update should allow the json_script filter to operate correctly even when no id is provided.
feature1.hint_texts: This part focuses on modifying the Django template filter to support an optional element_id. Developers need to update the file django/template/defaultfilters.py by changing the function signature of json_script to set element_id=None by default and adjust the docstring to indicate that the id is now optional. The implementation must ensure that the <script> tag renders correctly in templates when no id is supplied and that backward compatibility is maintained.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/template/defaultfilters.py; Function: json_script. Modify the definition from 'def json_script(value, element_id):' to 'def json_script(value, element_id=None):' and update the documentation accordingly.

feature2.prompt: Make the element_id argument of json_script optional. This update should ensure that the utility function for generating HTML output can operate without requiring an element id. With this change, json_script will conditionally include the id attribute in the <script> tag only when one is provided, thus supporting scenarios where the id is unnecessary. The behavior should be consistent and flexible for different use cases involving HTML rendering.
feature2.hint_texts: This part focuses on updating the Django utility function for HTML output. Developers must modify the file django/utils/html.py to update the json_script function by setting element_id=None by default. Additionally, the implementation should be adjusted to conditionally format the script tag so that the id attribute is only included if an element_id is provided. Consistency with the template filter's behavior is crucial.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/utils/html.py; Function: json_script. Update the function signature from 'def json_script(value, element_id):' to 'def json_script(value, element_id=None):' and modify the logic to conditionally include the id attribute in the output.
